site.source_description: Hypothetical Cs-137 boundary projection using the recharge composition generated in USGS PHREEQC Example 14
site.data_provenance: water composition transcribed from an official USGS PHREEQC example; source term and transport are demonstration inputs

provenance.water: USGS PHREEQC Example 14, Central Oklahoma aquifer, recharge solution 0 composition (Ca 0.191625, Mg 0.035797, Na 0.122668, Cl 0.133704, C 0.01096, S 0.235153 mmol/kgw)
provenance.cec: Same transparent 1.0-equivalent-per-liter mapping used for the paired brine case; not a site-measured value for this projection
provenance.selectivity: Na/Ca/Mg exchange coefficients follow the PHREEQC Gaines-Thomas database convention; Cs log K=1.2 is a demonstration placeholder requiring calibration against Cs multication experiments

query: Compare Cs exchange occupancy in the Central Oklahoma brine and recharge compositions using Na-Ca-Mg competition; preserve the result as comparative evidence only.
